notes: The ledger stores only public-safe summaries, entity identifiers, acceptance contracts, and content-free hashes.
The user-supplied bridge credential is treated as compromised and is never reproduced here.
Issue creation and a draft pull request are the only repository mutations represented by this planning ledger.

source_segments.incomplete_reason: No durable, independently readable export or continuous pagination receipt was available for this interval during this execution.

window.selection_basis: The fixed user-specified Google Chat interval is August 2 through September 3, 2026; broader sixty-day Linear and prior-chat inventory supplied prioritization context.

acceptance_checks: Enumerate every human-authored message and reply with continuous pagination receipts.
Map every actionable prompt to one canonical Linear issue and a resolvable GitHub issue or pull request.
Fail closed on missing pages, duplicate source identities, or unresolved actionable prompts.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Publish only content-free fingerprints, counts, identifiers, and redacted receipts.
workstreams.title: Prove the August 25 through September 3 Google Chat source delta

acceptance_checks: Validate exactly fifteen workstreams with strict schemas and deterministic canonical hashing.
Reject incomplete source coverage in closure mode while allowing explicit planning evidence.
Reject credentials, raw prompts, discontinuous source windows, and unresolved entity anchors.
workstreams.safety_boundary: The ledger records evidence and plans only; it cannot authorize merge, deploy, or external writes.
workstreams.title: Add a fail-closed Chat to Linear to GitHub execution ledger gate

acceptance_checks: Rotate the exposed credential and prove the prior value no longer authenticates.
Move authentication away from query strings and add constant-time comparison plus bounded requests.
Add redaction and secret-scan tests for URLs, logs, errors, fixtures, and receipts.
workstreams.safety_boundary: No credential value may appear in source, issues, pull requests, Linear, logs, or command arguments.
workstreams.title: Rotate exposed Chat intake credentials and eliminate egress paths

acceptance_checks: Bind both independent review receipts to the same repository, pull request, head SHA, and policy digest.
Reject self-review, identity collision, head drift, unresolved threads, and non-terminal checks.
Prove approve, request-changes, stale-head, unavailable-reviewer, and retry behavior in test organizations.
workstreams.safety_boundary: The gate strengthens existing review policy and never grants admin bypass or implicit auto-merge.
workstreams.title: Require independent ChatGPT and Claude review receipts at one exact head

acceptance_checks: Apply independent distributed budgets for network, device, user, tenant, route, and credential identifiers.
Persist atomic lockout state across retries, process loss, failover, and horizontal scaling.
Model concurrency, clock skew, partitions, replay, spray attacks, and recovery without leaking identifiers.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Production-wide enforcement waits for isolated canaries, accessibility review, and rollback evidence.
workstreams.title: Enforce layered rate limits and durable multi-factor lockout semantics

acceptance_checks: Propagate typed deadlines and cancellation through transports, queues, middleware, storage, and telemetry.
Separate stop-accepting, drain, flush, close, and forced termination with bounded deadlines.
Reproduce the Sonus Auris quit hang and prove deterministic termination with repeated lifecycle tests.
workstreams.safety_boundary: A process-kill workaround is insufficient without graceful durability and rollback evidence.
workstreams.title: Standardize request cancellation and eliminate shutdown and quit hangs

acceptance_checks: Run independent TypeSpec and JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 generation pipelines into isolated trees.
Normalize and compare interfaces, constraints, SQL, relations, errors, and evolution metadata.
Cross-check Diesel and SeaORM backend models and reject lossy mappings without reviewed waivers.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Generated output cannot replace reviewed artifacts until exact-head parity, compilation, and tests pass.
workstreams.title: Make TypeSpec and JSON Schema independent peer authorities with parity gates

acceptance_checks: Publish ten to fifteen immutable non-placeholder packages with checksums, licenses, and dependency metadata.
Build signed multi-platform native artifacts and deterministic lockfiles from reviewed source.
Install and execute clean external consumers across Rust, Dart, TypeScript, Go, and additional ecosystems.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Publication alone is not completion; clean registry consumers and rollback tests are required.
workstreams.title: Publish a verified Zed package tranche with native artifacts and clean consumers

acceptance_checks: Inventory required repository roles and detect missing, misplaced, duplicate, or orphaned resources.
Prove separate credentials, state, registries, environments, domains, and GitOps roots for test and production.
Emit exact-head end-to-end receipts for contracts, artifacts, deployment, health, rollback, and cleanup.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Repository creation, deployment, DNS, and database changes stay dry-run until reviewed and scoped.
workstreams.title: Enforce isolated production and test organization fleets with one E2E standard

acceptance_checks: Reconcile the required repository fleet, ownership, test mirrors, and dependency graph.
Adopt opto-sync, shared-auth, ores-middleware, ores-otel, and zed-pkg through versioned contracts.
Compile and test generated schemas, ORM parity, web, Flutter, Rust services, and background sync paths.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Production auth, data, synchronization, deployment, stores, and DNS remain disabled until test mirrors pass.
workstreams.title: Complete the Praxonne and Elenkos fleet and shared-platform adoption

acceptance_checks: Pin reproducible toolchains and build immutable multi-architecture images with SBOM and provenance.
Keep configuration encrypted and use workload identity or short-lived repository-scoped credentials.
Test rotation, offboarding, lost-key recovery, registry outage, rollback, and secret restoration.
workstreams.safety_boundary: Operational rotation or revocation requires owner review and proven recovery; automation must not revoke shared access.
workstreams.title: Unify Nix, SOPS and age, and OCI deployment evidence with recovery drills

acceptance_checks: Separate planner, coder, reviewer, tester, publisher, merger, deployer, and incident-response identities.
Require target allowlists, policy digests, budgets, leases, and idempotency keys for every mutation.
Model retries, crashes, revocation, partial success, split brain, replay, and concurrent workers.
workstreams.safety_boundary: No fallback credential may collapse planning, approval, merge, and deployment into one authority.
workstreams.title: Enforce role-scoped agent identities and guarded external mutations

acceptance_checks: Publish one versioned language-neutral SDK contract and shared behavioral vectors.
Generate types and validators independently from both schema authorities and compare normalized output.
Compile, lint, package, install, and execute at least fifteen maintained language targets in clean consumers.
workstreams.safety_boundary: A language counts only after an external clean consumer installs and executes the published package.
workstreams.title: Enforce fifteen-plus language SDK and validation-contract equivalence

acceptance_checks: Inventory direct and transitive auth integration by repository, runtime, version, and protected flow.
Run registration, login, refresh, recovery, organization, role, multi-factor, and revocation canaries.
Detect local auth forks, insecure fallback, stale keys, cross-environment trust, and shared production/test state.
workstreams.safety_boundary: No production tenant migration or key rotation occurs before isolated canaries and independent review.
workstreams.title: Verify shared-auth consumer adoption with isolated end-to-end canaries

acceptance_checks: Bind artifacts to exact repository, branch, commit, pull request, and Linear entity identities.
Reject local-only or stale evidence, wrong-repository attachments, duplicate delivery, and ambiguous matches.
Backfill partial failures idempotently while preserving unique provenance and redacting sensitive content.
workstreams.safety_boundary: An artifact receipt never proves merge, deployment, or completion without resolvable target-system evidence.
workstreams.title: Preserve generated artifacts through exact Linear and GitHub reconciliation
